bootstrap.method: paired stratified system bootstrap, percentile 95% intervals; fixed prevalence; no model refitting

planner_evaluation.top10_ties: Expected capture under random tie-breaking at the top-k boundary; k=floor(0.10*n).
planner_evaluation.normalization_cohort: All eligible non-Failing baseline systems, before filtering to known outcomes or At-Risk systems.

probability_calibration.target: Assessment snapshot transition; annual failure calibration unverified
probability_calibration.selection_rule: Lowest mean outer-fold log loss; prefer identity, then intercept, then logit_ridge within 0.001 of minimum. No test-year inputs.
limitations: Within one training transition; not forward-year validation.
Base configurations selected using the entire training transition; model selection is not nested.
Few training onsets; no subgroup-specific calibration or isotonic fitting.
Assessment status reference dates and July stage-1 cutoffs differ; some outcomes precede nominal prediction cutoffs. Annual failure calibration is unverified.
Five-year conversion 1-(1-p)^5 assumes constant annual risk and is not validated.
Full scoring covariates determine member normalization, including systems with unknown outcomes.

spatial_ablation.note: Failing-neighbour counts within 10 and 25 km added essentially nothing.

metrics.final_model_note: Final model refitted on 5266 system-years (129 snapshot positives), average of logistic, gradient_boosting, random_forest, extra_trees, stacked_logistic, each normalized over all 2574 scored systems to the pooled fitting rate (0.024), then mapped by frozen 2024-to-2025 calibration (logit_ridge). Calibration transfer to this refit is unvalidated. Annual failure probabilities remain unvalidated; 1-(1-p)^h assumes constant annual risk and is unvalidated.
metrics.fallback_note: Missing current At-Risk forecasts use the 2024-to-2025 training At-Risk snapshot rate, never the diagnostic outcome rate.
